nf00e1ef488.headline: German retail sales jump for second month in a row
nf00e1ef488.summary: German retail sales increased significantly in June, exceeding expectations following the easing of COVID-19 restrictions, supporting consumer demand recovery.
nf00e1ef488.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy; retail sales trends are key indicators of consumer confidence and economic momentum in the eurozone.
